# MDL308 · `flag-without-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An option written without `=`, such as `routines`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | §3.2, cases 12, 18 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl308-bare-flag-accepted-from-v0.19.3`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl308-bare-flag-accepted-from-v0.19.3.txtar) |

## Why

`routines` alone works because mydumper's pre-processor rewrites it into `routines= 1` before GLib reads the file. That rewrite is what the loading traps rely on: at the end of a file without a final newline, or after a line whose `[` leaks the pre-processor's state, the flag loses its `= 1` and the whole file is rejected; mydumper v0.19.1-x has no pre-processor at all (MDL113). `routines=1` works everywhere.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]
routines
  triggers\r
[client]
compress
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
2:1-2:9 info MDL308[flag-without-value] `routines` relies on mydumper's pre-processor to get its value: write `routines=1`
  fix (safe): Write the value explicitly (`routines=1`)
3:3-3:11 info MDL308[flag-without-value] `triggers` relies on mydumper's pre-processor to get its value: write `triggers=1`
  fix (safe): Write the value explicitly (`triggers=1`)
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```text
[mydumper]
routines=1
  triggers=1\r
[client]
compress
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL308: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL308` on the line above it.
